◆ DPM_mboxRemoteMailboxCallbackFxn()

static void DPM_mboxRemoteMailboxCallbackFxn ( RPMessage_Object *  obj,
void *  arg,
void *  data,
uint16_t  dataLen,
int32_t  crcStatus,
uint16_t  remoteCoreId,
uint16_t  remoteEndPt 
)
static

Description
This is the callback function which is registered with the mailbox and is invoked when a message is received from the remote peer.

Parameters
[in]objRPMessage end point object
[in]argArguments specified by user
[in]dataPointer to message
[in]dataLenLength of message
[in]crcStatusCRC Check status. SystemP_SUCCESS on success, else SystemP_FAILURE.
[in]remoteCoreIdCore ID of sender
[in]remoteEndPtEnd point of sender
Return values
NotApplicable.

◆ DPM_msgRecv()

Description
This is the function which is invoked to receive an IPC message Messages can be received from either:- (a) Local: One thread is trying to control the DPM Profile (b) Remote: One core is trying to control the profile executing on the remote domain. Process all the messages

[out]errCodeError code populated on error
Return values
